abstract: Maintains cold-ironing shore power verification and clean fuel efficiency credit terms
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (ENVIR). The Environmental compliance officer (ENVIR) is responsible for maintaining high-voltage shore power cold-ironing verifications, clean fuel propulsion efficiency credit terms, and vessel eco-hull biofouling management schedules across candidate offshore service vessel fleets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hull biofouling management（BIOFOUL）
information_points.content:
ENVIR-BIOFOUL-TQ4：Celtic Horizon Marine Services maintains an acoustic hull inspection interval of 6 months for certified subsea ultrasonic hull scans.
ENVIR-BIOFOUL-UNS：According to the eco-hull maintenance schedule, the acoustic hull inspection interval for the North Sea Guardian Offshore Consortium is 3 months between certified subsea ultrasonic scans.
ENVIR-BIOFOUL-ABL：The eco-hull maintenance schedule specifies an acoustic hull inspection interval of 12 months for the Baltic Wind Voyager Fleet Group.

information_points.title: Maintains cold-ironing shore power verification and clean fuel efficiency credit terms（GREENOPS）
information_points.content:
ENVIR-GREENOPS-11R：For the North Sea Guardian Offshore Consortium, high-voltage shore power cold-ironing readiness is confirmed as true based on certified availability of onboard shore connection hardware for zero-emission port stays, and the contractual propulsion efficiency rebate is 3,500 EUR/day under the green charter incentive schedule.
ENVIR-GREENOPS-ZTT：For Celtic Horizon Marine Services, high-voltage shore power cold-ironing readiness is true with certified onboard hardware for harbor shore connections, and the propulsion efficiency rebate is 2,500 EUR/day.
ENVIR-GREENOPS-M8F：For the Baltic Wind Voyager Fleet Group, high-voltage shore power cold-ironing readiness is false as onboard high-voltage shore connection hardware is not certified available, while the propulsion efficiency rebate is 1,500 EUR/day for hybrid battery and dual-fuel propulsion.
